Each connection occupies one compact table row with four cells: target and application icon/name; matched rule and actual outbound; upload and download speed; close and details. Each cell stacks its two items vertically, with icons aligned to the text.

Opening this page starts automatic updates. Leaving it or putting the app in the background cancels polling and the pending request. Search by application, package, target or rule; sort from column headings or the sort menu. Details retain addresses, total bytes, the full proxy chain and Add to rule set.

Speed requires two successful samples; the first or resumed sample shows a dash. Memory holds up to 2,000 active records and the latest 100 observed endings, allowing repeated apps and targets. When limited, the active count shows the total and the status shows the retained count; search and bulk close apply to retained rows only. No connection history is collected off-page or in the background, and brief connections between samples can be missed. Leaving the page does not close proxy connections. Closing requires confirmation. Invalid or oversized responses keep the previous snapshot with unknown speed and retry less often. Unknown app ownership is not guessed; unavailable local icons use a generic icon.
Create a rule set or append a literal domain, IP/CIDR or app package rule to a compatible local rule set. Review the generated rule before saving.
A domain becomes DOMAIN-SUFFIX, an IP becomes a host CIDR, and an Android app package becomes PROCESS-NAME. Existing domain and ipcidr sets accept their matching type.

Android uses application package names for PROCESS-NAME, not APK paths, installation folders or URL paths. This VPN metadata contains a domain/IP and port, not an HTTP URL path. Saving does not select an outbound: reference a new rule set from a policy group and associate it with a subscription; restart the VPN to apply candidate changes.
Read the real mihomo log stream. The More menu shows Logs only when Home log level is not Silent.
Filter by level or text, pause, follow new entries, clear the buffer, tap for details or copy filtered entries. Level filters only change the display.

Keep at most 500 entries in memory. Leaving the page or backgrounding the app stops collection; a new VPN session clears old entries. Logs are never saved automatically and may contain browsing destinations.
Compare A and AAAA answers from proxy, direct and custom resolvers. Accept a domain or HTTP/HTTPS URL; only its hostname is queried.
Enter a resolver IP for DNS over TCP port 53, or an HTTPS DoH URL. Custom DNS can use direct or proxy routing. Each result shows its server, route and elapsed time.

Proxy queries require an active VPN and a usable proxy leaf under the subscription MATCH target. They never fall back to direct or change user selectors. Direct queries work offline. Queries time out after 12 seconds and cancel when the page is hidden or the VPN session changes.
